title: 我叫無人
tags: Cinematic orchestral score with traditional Chinese vocal elements. A solo baritone male voice performs a spoken word delivery in Mandarin Chinese. The arrangement features a sustained string ensemble providing a lush harmonic bed. A solo cello plays a mournful, legato melody in the lower register. A traditional Chinese flute, the dizi, performs ornamental trills and breathy melodic flourishes. The tempo is a slow, rubato 60 BPM. The piece is in the key of D minor. The production uses high-density hall reverb to create a wide spatial image. The dynamics are controlled and steady, focusing on the interplay between the spoken narration and the woodwind accents.
